reachability: Private, so only `_move` (FeeRouteLib.sol:68) reaches it — the floor-vault leg of the split. The native branch forwards ALL remaining gas to an address the protocol chose (`vault`), and the ERC20 branch checks the return payload at `abi` (FeeRouteLib.sol:110), treating an empty return as success and decoding a bool otherwise. A revert inside the recipient is swallowed by the low-level call and surfaces as `ok` (FeeRouteLib.sol:105) false.

reachability: Private; reached from `_fundGuild` (FeeRouteLib.sol:64) and `_fundGuild` (FeeRouteLib.sol:97). Native uses the guild's bare receive; an ERC20 is approved and then pulled by `fundToken` (FeeRouteLib.sol:132) so the dividend can account for it. The approval is only cleared when the pull reports failure at `ok` (FeeRouteLib.sol:134); a pull that succeeds but consumes less than the approved amount leaves the remainder standing. Every call's result is captured rather than bubbled, so this can never revert the swap that produced the fee.
